title: Wagent
tagline: Easiest way to onboard users into the world of new digital dollars
description: This project completely removes the complexity of onchain transactions, by making the use of decision making agents to allow the users to only aware about the dollars theyve in the account which are tied to their base names which is minted when they onboard, whether theyve funds fragmented on different chains or even non-stable coins, everything is shown in simple dollars as users are familiar with right now.
how_its_made:
- The project extends the agentkit to implement multiple custom action providers
- The custom send provider checks the cheapest chain to do the transaction and does using that, if the user does not have enough funds on the target chain, the agent autonomously bridges the required funds from different chains and prepares for sending
- If the user has non-stable coins, we have a linear regression model to predict the price in a cronjob, if the price even affectes the initial balance by 0.5% decrease then its converted to stable coins, cause the new user should see their dollar losing for nothing, otherwise incase of increment the token in kept.
-In case of subscriptions, the agents talk among each other to send prompts in a cronjob and get the required funds when needed
